title: Bug 2024725 - Protocol handler for net.thunderbird links. r=jtracey Registers 'net.thunderbird' protocol with the OS, and sets Thunderbird as the handler when setting Thunderbird as the default handler for mail. Thunderbird will then handle URLs of the form 'net.thunderbird://component/arguments' where 'component' is the name of a component registered in the category manager. The URL is passed to the `observe` function on the component.
